notes.title: Docs preview ports
notes.body: The docs preview server listens on 127.0.0.1:4310 behind the dev proxy on 4311. Loopback only; the proxy adds the auth header.

notes.title: Package manager
notes.body: Use pnpm for this monorepo; never run npm install inside packages/api. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile is what CI runs.

notes.title: Webhook retry budget
notes.body: Webhook deliveries retry with exponential backoff for up to six attempts; after the sixth failure the event moves to the dead-letter queue.

notes.title: Certificate renewal
notes.body: Certificates renew through the ACME client every 60 days. The renewal hook reloads nginx; it must never restart nginx.

notes.title: Search UI flag
notes.body: Feature flags live in flags.yaml. The beta-search flag gates the new search UI for staff accounts only.

notes.title: Thumbnail worker concurrency
notes.body: The thumbnail queue worker runs with concurrency 4; raising it past 8 exhausts the image service's connection pool.

notes.title: Analytics host port
notes.body: Self-hosted analytics runs on port 8123, not 8080 or 8000. Query it with the read-only reporting user.

notes.title: Deploys replace the tree
notes.body: Every release replaces the whole /srv/app tree, so persistent state must live under /var/lib/app.

notes.title: Container restart batches
notes.body: Restart worker containers in batches of three with 90-second gaps; never restart the whole pool at once.

notes.title: Embedding dimensions
notes.body: The brain embeds every chunk at 1536 dimensions, so vectors written by every importer stay comparable.

notes.title: Database backups
notes.body: The primary database has point-in-time recovery; a nightly logical dump runs at 03:00 with seven-day retention.

notes.title: Brand colors
notes.body: The marketing site uses teal #1F8A8A on a warm sand background, and never pure black text.

notes.title: Payments cutover state (old)
notes.body: The cutover to the new payments provider is not yet applied; the canary store passed its readiness check in PR 214.

notes.title: Payments cutover state
notes.body: The payments provider cutover was applied on 2026-09-21 at 04:37 UTC; the canary store is proven end to end on the new provider.

notes.title: Search service port (old)
notes.body: The search service API is reachable on port 7700.

notes.title: Search service port
notes.body: The search service API moved to port 7702 under the search-svc account; port 7700 is deprecated.

notes.title: Sourdough schedule
notes.body: Feed the starter twice a day at 78F; bulk ferment four hours; bake at 475F in a dutch oven.

notes.title: Tempo run plan
notes.body: Tuesday tempo: 2 miles easy, 4 miles at threshold, 1 mile cooldown. Long run Sunday.

notes.title: Tomato staking
notes.body: Stake indeterminate tomatoes at transplant; prune suckers below the first flower cluster.

notes.title: A full disk breaks the shell tool
notes.body: A full disk makes the shell tool's output file fail with ENOSPC; check df before installing dependencies.
